name: Orthogonal Culling Optimization
definition: A technique to reduce the number of objects evaluated per march step by calculating potential hits before the Sphere Tracing loop begins, using orthogonal projection.
summary: Orthogonal Culling Optimization is a pre-computation technique that reduces SDF evaluations by testing ray-object intersections via orthogonal projection, differing from other methods by avoiding CPU-side broad-phase culling.
